1. Read packages/runtime/src/task/ledger.ts in full (ledgerKey, entries, verify, rerenderView) and grep for enforceFallback/repoAutonomy/autonomyEntries callers in packages/runtime and packages/cli. That shows every path that reads or appends to the autonomy ledger and confirms entries() throws on a malformed line.

2. In packages/runtime/src/task/ladder.ts, add a `verification: { ok: boolean; problems: string[] }` field to LadderState. In ladder(), open autonomyLedger(repoPath) and call verify() inside a try/catch, so a key or read error becomes a failed verification with that error as its problem.

3. Still in ladder(): when verification fails, skip autonomyEntries (it would throw on bad JSON, and its entries can't be trusted). Use entries [] and entry null, force effective to 'supervised', and set fallback to a plain sentence: 'the autonomy ledger at .factory/autonomy fails verification: <problems>'. When verification passes, run the existing code path unchanged (A4).

4. Make enforceFallback return the state without calling record() when state.verification.ok is false, because append would throw on that ledger (A3). Leave setAutonomy as it is, so the existing ladder.test.ts expectation that appending to a forged ledger rejects with /fails verification/ still holds. Add no new code comments (diff.no-new-comments).

5. In packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts renderLadder, when trust.verification.ok is false: add an 'Autonomy ledger' line saying it failed verification and the repo runs supervised, followed by one indented line per problem. The JSON output carries the field automatically.

6. In packages/cli/src/commands/hook.ts sessionStartText, call ladder(root) with .catch(() => null). When verification failed, push lines saying the autonomy ledger at .factory/autonomy failed verification, list each problem, and say the repo runs supervised. Session start must always complete (A2, A3).

7. Add packages/runtime/src/task/ladder-verify.test.ts using the same temp FACTORY_CONFIG_DIR and repo setup as ladder.test.ts. A1: after setAutonomy to review-at-pr with an override, editing an entry in ledger.jsonl, or separately editing ledger.md, gives effective 'supervised' with configured 'review-at-pr' and verification problems. A3: a non-JSON line resolves ladder() and enforceFallback() without throwing and appends nothing. A4: an intact ledger gives effective review-at-pr, the same entries, and verification.ok true.

8. Add packages/cli/src/commands/ladder-verify.test.ts. Tamper with the autonomy ledger of a review-at-pr repo, then assert that runMetrics(dir, { findings: true }, { token: null }) returns 0 and its stdout names the failed verification, the problems and 'supervised'. Assert that sessionStartText(repo) resolves and contains the same. Also assert that an intact ledger produces none of those lines.

9. Run only the related tests: `pnpm vitest related --run packages/runtime/src/task/ladder.ts packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts packages/cli/src/commands/hook.ts`, building workspace packages first if the CLI resolves @arynbht/factory-runtime from dist. Then run `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run lint` and fix anything they report.
10. Run `pnpm action:build`, because packages/runtime/src and packages/cli changed, and stage the regenerated packages/action/dist/**.

11. Add .changeset/verify-autonomy-ledger.md with patch bumps for "@arynbht/factory-runtime" and "@arynbht/factory". Say that the trust ladder now verifies .factory/autonomy before reading it, treats a failed ledger as supervised, and that factory metrics and session start name the problems.
12. Commit on fix/t-0014 with a conventional header of at most 72 characters, such as 'fix(runtime): verify the autonomy ledger before the ladder reads it', ending with the Co-Authored-By line.
